verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a browser-automation platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents a way to run Notte yourself. The docs describe cloud-hosted sessions, serverless functions and a hosted API that requires Bearer tokens. The GitHub repo is mentioned only for its agent and scripting features, with no statement that the core product can be deployed on your own infrastructure. 'Bring your own keys' on the pricing page is an adjacent feature, not self-hosting.
